response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong software craftsmanship and some high-performance systems exposure, but the profile fundamentally misaligns with this role's core requirements. He has only ~6 months of professional C++ (National Instruments) versus the required 8 years, his career centers on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure, and he has no formal technical leadership or people-mentoring role despite mentoring-adjacent activities like workshops and dojos.
strengths: Strong systems-adjacent experience: low-latency, high-throughput microservices at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic handling millions of requests per second
Demonstrated mentoring inclination through workshops, code katas, courses, and open-source project leadership (GISCollective)
Deep testing and engineering-practices background (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, test frameworks authored in DLang)
concerns: Falls far short of the 8-year C++ requirement — only a brief C/C++ stint plus a thesis project
No dedicated cloud compute platform or large-scale distributed infrastructure ownership; experience is mostly product/web engineering
No formal technical-leadership title or track record of leading cross-team strategy, priorities, and deliverables
